title: Vibe Coding for Product Managers: Build Your Own Prototypes and Ship Faster
summary: Product managers who vibe code ship 3x faster — build clickable prototypes, internal tools, and user research instruments without waiting for dev bandwidth.
body_markdown: It depends on what you need after the frontend. Pure visual prototyping with no data collection? Figma still works. But for any prototype where you need users to submit real responses, see real data, or test real interactions — you need a database, auth, and hosting. Blink bundles all three. No separate Supabase account, no Clerk dashboard, no Vercel config. Full-stack from day one, not just the UI layer.
